desc: Read input N, M and the list of pre-colored cells.
Initialize dictionaries `R_min` and `C_min` to store lower bounds for row and column thresholds.
Iterate through all black cells: for cell (x, y, 'B'), update `R_min[x] = max(R_min.get(x, 0), y)` and `C_min[y] = max(C_min.get(y, 0), x)`.
Iterate through all white cells: for cell (x, y, 'W'), check if `R_min.get(x, 0) < y` OR `C_min.get(y, 0) < x`. If neither is true, return "No".
If all white cells pass the check, return "Yes".
